# stripe_invoice resource: `last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix`

The `last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix` attribute of the [`stripe_invoice`](../resources/invoice) resource, on a page of its own to keep that page within the Registry's size limit.

<a id="last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix"></a>
### `last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix`

The `last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix` attribute supports:

* `amount_includes_iof` - Determines if the amount includes the IOF tax. Possible values: `always`, `never`.
* `capture_method` - Controls when the funds will be captured from the customer's account. Possible values: `automatic_delayed`, `manual`, `manual_preferred`.
* `expires_after_seconds` - The number of seconds (between 10 and 1209600) after which Pix payment will expire.
* `expires_at` - The timestamp at which the Pix expires.
* `installments` - See [`last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix.installments`](#last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix.installments) below.
* `mandate_options` - See [`last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix.mandate_options`](#last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix.mandate_options) below.
* `request_incremental_authorization_support` - Request ability to [increment](https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/incremental-authorizations) this PaymentIntent if the combination of MCC and card brand is eligible. Check [incremental_authorization_supported](https://docs.stripe.com/api/charges/object#charge_object-payment_method_details-card_present-incremental_authorization_supported) in the [Confirm](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents/confirm) response to verify support.
* `require_cvc_recollection` - When enabled, using a card that is attached to a customer will require the CVC to be provided again (i.e. using the cvc_token parameter).
* `routing` - See [`last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix.routing`](#last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix.routing) below.
* `setup_future_usage` - Indicates that you intend to make future payments with this PaymentIntent's payment method. If you provide a Customer with the PaymentIntent, you can use this parameter to [attach the payment method](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/save-during-payment) to the Customer after the PaymentIntent is confirmed and the customer completes any required actions. If you don't provide a Customer, you can still [attach](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_methods/attach) the payment method to a Customer after the transaction completes. If the payment method is `card_present` and isn't a digital wallet, Stripe creates and attaches a [generated_card](https://docs.stripe.com/api/charges/object#charge_object-payment_method_details-card_present-generated_card) payment method representing the card to the Customer instead. When processing card payments, Stripe uses `setup_future_usage` to help you comply with regional legislation and network rules, such as [SCA](https://docs.stripe.com/strong-customer-authentication). Possible values: `none`, `off_session`, `on_session`.
* `verification_method` - Bank account verification method. The default value is `automatic`. Possible values: `automatic`, `instant`, `microdeposits`.

<a id="last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix.installments"></a>
### `last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix.installments`

The `last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix.installments` attribute supports:

* `enabled` -
* `plan` - See [`last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix.installments.plan`](#last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix.installments.plan) below.

<a id="last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix.installments.plan"></a>
### `last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix.installments.plan`

The `last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix.installments.plan` attribute supports:

* `count` - For `fixed_count` installment plans, this is the number of installment payments your customer will make to their credit card.
* `interval` - For `fixed_count` installment plans, this is the interval between installment payments your customer will make to their credit card. One of `month`. Possible values: `month`.
* `type` - Type of installment plan, one of `fixed_count`, `bonus`, or `revolving`. Possible values: `bonus`, `fixed_count`, `revolving`.

<a id="last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix.mandate_options"></a>
### `last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix.mandate_options`

The `last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix.mandate_options` attribute supports:

* `amount` - Amount to be charged for future payments.
* `amount_includes_iof` - Determines if the amount includes the IOF tax. Possible values: `always`, `never`.
* `amount_type` - Type of amount. Possible values: `fixed`, `maximum`.
* `currency` - Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase.
* `end_date` - Date when the mandate expires and no further payments will be charged, in `YYYY-MM-DD`.
* `payment_schedule` - Schedule at which the future payments will be charged. Possible values: `halfyearly`, `monthly`, `quarterly`, `weekly`, `yearly`, `adhoc`, `annual`, `daily`, `fortnightly`, `semi_annual`.
* `payments_per_period` - The number of payments that will be made during a payment period. Defaults to 1 except for when `payment_schedule` is `adhoc`. In that case, it defaults to no limit.
* `purpose` - The purpose for which payments are made. Has a default value based on your merchant category code. Possible values: `dependant_support`, `government`, `loan`, `mortgage`, `other`, `pension`, `personal`, `retail`, `salary`, `tax`, `utility`.
* `reference` - Subscription name displayed to buyers in their bank app.
* `start_date` - Start date of the mandate, in `YYYY-MM-DD`.

<a id="last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix.routing"></a>
### `last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix.routing`

The `last_finalization_error.payment_intent.payment_method_options.pix.routing` attribute supports:

* `requested_priority` - Requested routing priority Possible values: `domestic`, `international`.
